name: Love Under the Spotlight
source:
Just as you’re about to give up on your dream, you meet three captivating men.
Together, you decide to form a new musical troupe in honor of a legendary group that mysteriously disbanded.
However, each of them carries their own burdens, and one obstacle after another stands in your way.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.gekidanotome]Google Play[/url]]
